capabilities: garble all text in the app for screenshots
blur images while text is garbled
toggle garbling via the command palette
extras: The README states the plugin is no longer maintained; planned but unfinished features include regex-based garbling and a mobile toolbar icon.
problem: Taking screenshots of a vault for sharing or support risks exposing private note content, and Obsidian has no built-in way to obscure it.
summary: Privacy tool that garbles all text in the app and blurs images so screenshots can be shared without exposing sensitive data.
